stories.h: Man freed from prison hours earlier charged in Everett killing
stories.s: A 40-year-old Lynnwood man faces first-degree murder and other charges in an Oct. 26 south Everett shooting that killed one brother and wounded another, less than 12 hours after his release from state custody.

stories.h: Arrest made in Marysville yard-waste-bin body case
stories.s: Police arrested a 49-year-old Marysville neighbor on misdemeanor charges of concealing a body after Sarah Arneklev was found in a yard waste bin in April. Her cause of death remains pending.

stories.h: Everett launches $7M fund to curb south Everett displacement
stories.s: The South Everett Futures Fund aims to protect 1,000 homes, add 1,250 affordable units and support 100 businesses near future light rail stations over ten years, with city, county and philanthropic money.

stories.h: Snohomish PUD offers bill credits to cut peak power use
stories.s: The PUD's voluntary Peak Assist program, starting Jan. 1, asks residential customers to reduce use during up to two short peak events a month, with a $25 credit for enrolling and participating.

coming.h: Lynnwood council expected to vote on 24/7 speed cameras
coming.s: Lynnwood may run two school-zone cameras around the clock and add two on 44th Ave W to help close a roughly $1M budget gap; changes could start by February.

coming.h: Nightly SR 527 lane closures at Canyon Park
coming.s: Up to two northbound SR 527 lanes near I-405 close 9 p.m.-4 a.m. Monday through Wednesday nights, along with the northbound SR 527 on-ramp to northbound I-405.
